text:
Riley (People Ops): Heads-up everyone ":wave:" — were launching the Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance program today. Short summary below, will post full policy page and Q&A. Please share with folks who might benefit.

Riley (People Ops): TL;DR: New reimbursement stipend up to $5,000 per child for adoption or surrogacy-related expenses, plus up to 8 weeks of bonding leave (can be taken intermittently) on top of standard parental leave. Effective immediately.

Evan (Benefits): Reimbursements cover agency fees, legal expenses, travel related to placement, and reasonable medical costs not covered by insurance. Well require itemized receipts and a short confirmation of placement (redacted OK). Processing target is 2 pay cycles.

Priya (Legal): Confidentiality note: employees can provide redacted documents. Weve added an attestation form to avoid sensitive medical details. Benefits will never ask for medical records.

Noah (Eng): For planning purposes, does the 8 weeks stack with disability or other parental leave? e.g., if someone takes FMLA or state disability.

Evan (Benefits): Good Q. This bonding leave is additive to Redwoods standard parental benefits, but interfacing with state disability/FMLA depends on local law. Well coordinate and flag in the approval email if any external paperwork is needed.

Riley (People Ops): How to request: submit the "Adoption/Surrogacy Assistance" form in HR portal and attach receipts and placement confirmation. Choose "bonding leave" if requesting time off. There's an "expedite" checkbox for last-minute placement travel.

People Ops Bot: Quick link: <https://redwood-internal/hr/leave/adoption-surrogacy> Webinar scheduled Wed 11AM PT for FAQs. :calendar:

Priya (Legal): For managers: please treat requests as private and coordinate with People Ops for coverage planning. Avoid asking for more than the attestation and receipts.

Evan (Benefits): Sample receipt checklist posted on the page. If you paid upfront and need faster cash, contact benefits@redwood.com with "fast-track" in the subject and a photo of the primary receipt. Well try to front $1,500 in urgent cases.

Noah (Eng): Thanks 1 — will pass to my team. Any guidance for international employees?

Riley (People Ops): International: program applies worldwide, but stipend amounts are USD and subject to local tax treatment. Were coordinating with payroll/Local HR to handle tax and statutory leave interactions. For country-specific rules, link has regional notes.

Riley (People Ops): Example email template for managers to notify team about coverage (on the policy page):

```
Subject: Coverage plan while [Name] is on bonding leave
Dates: [start] to [end or intermittent dates]
Coverage: [handoff notes, who to contact]
Urgent contact: [backup]
```

Riley (People Ops): Final: this was driven by employee feedback and the Family Benefits survey. If you see edge cases or want clarifications, DM me or drop questions in the webinar. :seedling:
